articles.title: Five Wynn Restaurants Recognized in the 2027 LA LISTE The World's Best Restaurant Selection
articles.summary: Macao, October 12, 2026 – Five Wynn restaurants were included in the 2027 LA LISTE The World's Best Restaurant Selection: Chef Tam's Seasons, Lakeview Palace, Mizumi and SW Steakhouse at Wynn Palace, and Wing Lei at Wynn Macau. They were recognised at the Greater China Region Awards Ceremony in Changzhou, China.

articles.title: MGM’s Two Restaurants Again Named Among La Liste’s Top 1000 World’s Best Restaurants 2027
articles.summary: [October 12, 2026, Macau] Imperial Court and Five Foot Road were again named among La Liste’s Top 1,000 World’s Best Restaurants 2027, their second consecutive year on the list. The recognition reflects both restaurants’ culinary standards and MGM’s commitment to promoting Chinese culinary culture.

articles.title: Wynn Supports Welfare Shop Project of Macau Holy House of Mercy for 14th Consecutive Year
articles.summary: Macao, October 10, 2026 – Wynn continued its 14th consecutive year of support for the Welfare Shop Project of Macau Holy House of Mercy, donating MOP300,000 and sponsoring food hampers for 371 underprivileged families. Around 40 Wynn volunteers helped distribute rice, noodles, canned food, edible oil and other daily necessities at the SCMM Welfare Shop.

articles.title: ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Successfully Concludes
articles.rawDate: Oct.11 ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Successfully Concludes
articles.summary: (Macao, Oct. 11, 2026) – The five-day NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026 closed with a Community Basketball Carnival at NBA HOUSE at The Venetian Macao. NBA legend Chris Bosh and Sands Global Ambassador Sir David Beckham joined about 200 participants, including members of Macau Special Olympics and families from social service organisations.

articles.title: Sands China Joins Hands with NBA Legend to Distribute Boxed Lunches to the Macao Community
articles.rawDate: Oct.10 Sands China Joins Hands with NBA Legend to Distribute Boxed Lunches to the Macao Community
articles.summary: (Macao, Oct. 10, 2026) – On Health and Wellness Day, Sands China and NBA Cares assembled boxed lunches with NBA legends Stephon Marbury and Cuttino Mobley at Fuhong Society of Macau’s Happy Kitchen. The initiative will benefit 1,500 people, and a plaque was unveiled to mark the social enterprise’s new service.

articles.title: ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Celebrates Tip-Off
articles.rawDate: Oct.8 ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Celebrates Tip-Off
articles.summary: (Macao, Oct. 8, 2026) – Sands China and NBA Cares held Tip-Off Day at The Venetian Arena with about 400 participants, including Dallas Mavericks and Houston Rockets players, NBA legends and coaches, and local school basketball teams. Players mentored championship teams from Keang Peng School and Colégio Dom Bosco (Yuet Wah) and led a basketball clinic.

articles.title: SJM Hosts National Day Reception with Over 2,000 Team Members to Celebrate the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People’s Republic of China
articles.summary: (Macau, 8 October 2026) — SJM hosted a National Day reception at Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau with over 2,000 team members to mark the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China. Chairman Dr. Timothy Fok and Managing Director Daisy Ho joined a flag-raising ceremony and toast with staff.

articles.title: Wynn Officially Unveils the Highly Acclaimed 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards in November
articles.summary: Macao, October 8, 2026 — “Wynn Signature” will unveil the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards calendar on November 9, 2026, with entries opening March 1, 2027. In a first for the awards, Beijing will host Judging Week from August 21 to 25, 2027, and the Awards Ceremony will be held in Macao on October 29, 2027.

articles.title: Sands China Launches ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’
articles.rawDate: Oct.7 Sands China Launches ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’
articles.summary: (Macao, Oct. 7, 2026) – Sands China and NBA Cares launched the five-day Community Impact Week 2026 (Oct. 7–11) with Youth Day at the Macao East Asian Games Dome. NBA legend Ray Allen and Ding Yanyuhang joined 150 young players from eight Macao schools and 50 from Hong Kong and mainland GBA cities.

articles.title: Sands Resorts Macao Wins ‘Best Integrated Resort (Asia)’ at Travel Weekly Asia Readers’ Choice Awards 2026
articles.rawDate: Oct.6 Sands Resorts Macao Wins ‘Best Integrated Resort (Asia)’ at Travel Weekly Asia Readers’ Choice Awards 2026
articles.summary: (Macao, Oct. 6, 2026) – Sands Resorts Macao was named Best Integrated Resort (Asia) at the Travel Weekly Asia Readers’ Choice Awards 2026. The destination comprises The Venetian Macao, The Parisian Macao and The Londoner Macao.
